result: Viral capsids spontaneously overcharge during assembly, meaning the negative charge of the nucleic acid exceeds the positive charge on the capsid, without requiring external driving forces. This overcharging arises from geometric constraints and electrostatic screening, where discrete positive charges in ARMs limit direct NA-protein interactions, leading to bridging segments between charges that are the primary origin of overcharging.
